# The Onion

> The Onion is a satirical news organization that uses humor and parody to comment on current events, politics, entertainment, and culture.

The Onion produces satirical articles, video content through its Onion News Network, and merchandise, covering everything from political satire to absurdist humor about everyday situations. The site serves as a comedy publication that deconstructs news media conventions through exaggerated parody.
